outcome: Breastfeeding in the first hour of life
Practice of breastfeeding at twelve months from birth
cohort: The study included 541 children born at term, followed prospectively for one year.
finding: There was no association between the category gestational age at term and breastfeeding in the first hour of life, duration of exclusive breastfeeding, or the practice of breastfeeding twelve months from birth.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was observed to have a negative influence on breastfeeding.
